meta.name: avatar-extraction
meta.description: Use when you need to define exactly who the buyer is, what they want, what they’ve tried, and what’s driving their decisions. Trigger on "target audience", "ideal client", "who is this for", "avatar", "customer profile".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义目标客户画像与购买动机
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要精准描述理想客户是谁、想要什么。
copy.tagline_en: Define buyer personas and purchase motivations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to precisely describe who your ideal customer is and what drives them.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像买家心理学家一样，帮你定义出具体的理想客户画像，包括他们的身份、目标、痛点、失败尝试和情感驱动因素。
howto.when: 当你提到“目标受众”、“理想客户”、“这是为谁做的”、“客户画像”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我定义我的理想客户画像。
say.note: Claude 会开始询问客户细节并输出完整画像。

say.text: 分析一下我的目标受众的痛点和失败尝试。
say.note: Claude 会提取客户的具体痛点和已尝试的失败方案。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a buyer psychologist to define a specific ideal customer profile, including identity, goals, pain points, failed attempts, and emotional drivers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "target audience", "ideal client", "who is this for", "avatar", or "customer profile".

say_en.note: Claude will ask details and output a full profile.

say_en.text: Analyze the pain points and failed attempts of my target audience.
say_en.note: Claude will extract specific pains and failed solutions.
